business_process: Outage and field radiation protection support
description: On-site work at Client A during refueling outages (ALARA planning; radiation work permit reviews; dose assessments; job coverage) and radiation surveys at other client sites
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Outage windows are fixed and Client A replaces a contractor who misses more than a day; outage work is about 55% of receipts (about $1,500 a day on site); wrong or missing survey and dose data can lead to unplanned worker exposure; RPO set by the gap between field notes and the next data download
manual_workaround: Work from Client A's own workstations and printed work packages on site; paper field notebooks; the per-diem technician covers surveys for up to one shift
dependent_third_parties: Client A (portal; unescorted access status); calibration laboratory; phone carrier
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner-consultant (single point of failure; the only person who can sign Client A deliverables)

description: Dose assessments; shielding calculations; annual radiation protection program review reports; Client B Part 37 security program review support; survey reports
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Client deliverables are due in days, not hours (2026 Client B review report due 2026-11-30); a lost or altered calculation can change shielding or dose conclusions; RPO 24 hours relies on file sync and 30-day version history
manual_workaround: Re-run calculations from field notebooks and source data in the client portals; ask clients for a short extension
dependent_third_parties: Email and file suite provider; Client A portal; Client B secure share

business_process: Client communications and secure document exchange
description: Email; calls and texts with client radiation protection staff; Client A contractor portal; Client B secure share; contract notices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: CSR-A (5) requires a report to Client A within 8 hours and CSIA-B (4) a report to Client B within 24 hours; outage coordination runs by phone and email daily
manual_workaround: Phone calls from the mobile phone; Client A and Client B portals reached from the phone browser; printed contact list
dependent_third_parties: Email and file suite provider; phone carrier; Client A; Client B

description: Calibration tracking; response checks; downloading survey meter data; keeping raw survey records that clients rely on
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: An instrument past its calibration date cannot be used for client surveys (licensees must ensure instruments are calibrated periodically, 10 CFR 20.1501(c)); RPO 24 hours is not supported today because raw survey data on the field laptop has no backup
manual_workaround: Use client-owned calibrated instruments on site; record readings by hand in the field notebook; calibration certificates also arrive by email from the laboratory

description: Invoicing; receivables; the per-diem technician's pay and W-9; insurance and tax records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Cash flow: about $3,500 billed a week and clients pay in 30 days; savings cover about two months of expenses
manual_workaround: Invoice from the email suite using a saved template; use the bank portal directly
dependent_third_parties: Accounting SaaS vendor; bank; tax accountant
